summary.tldr: Classifies the murder of an intimate partner, the person’s own child, or an intimate partner’s child as first degree murder.
what_it_does: Classifies the murder of an intimate partner, the person’s own child, or an intimate partner’s child as first degree murder.
Makes that rule apply even if the murder was not planned and deliberate.
summary.background: Section 231 of the Criminal Code sets out when murder is first degree murder. This bill adds a new rule to that section.
